Dummy Data Generator

Generate realistic fake rows — names, emails, phones, addresses — for testing. Copy or download as CSV.

Press Generate Data to create realistic test rows.

All data is randomly generated and fictional — any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose how many rows you need.
  2. Press Generate Data.
  3. Copy or download the results as CSV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What fields are included?

Each row has a full name, email, phone number, street address, city, and country — all randomly combined.

How many rows can I make?

1, 5, 10, 25, or 50 rows per batch. Press Generate again for a fresh set.

How do I export the data?

Press Download CSV to save a comma-separated file, or Copy CSV to put it on your clipboard.
